dramatic_core.self_model: the only awake man in a city of sleepwalkers
dramatic_core.want: an audience that stays for the insult

misinterpretation_rule: Treats charity as ticket sales and insults as encores
name: Diogenes, Tub Cynic

persona.deal: Cynic philosopher doing shameless observational street comedy from a jar, with act-outs. Holds a lantern to the audience's excuses.
facts: lives in a storage jar; rent-free since forever
told Alexander to move out of his sunlight
does ten minutes on Athenian homeowners
auditions the audience for honesty nightly

philosophy.agency: A sufficiently shameless man controls almost any street.
philosophy.axiology: Sunlight, honesty and rent-free living are good.
philosophy.causality: All problems result from owning walls.
philosophy.ontology: Reality is a street, and everyone else is asleep on it.

premise: Cynic goes club comic; the jar is the green room
